name: lattice
description: Lattice on your Urbit ship as Claude's memory, and your wiki and other ships' pages as its knowledge.

ship_url.title: Ship URL
ship_url.description: Your ship's web address, such as https://urbit.example.com

key.title: Agent key
key.description: Make one in lattice: Settings, Agent keys

recall_strength.title: Prompt recall strength
recall_strength.description: Add memories to a prompt only when the best match is at least this strong (0 to 100). 101 turns prompt recall off.
